answers.1:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: gpu-pod
spec:
  tolerations:
  - key: dedicated
    operator: Equal       # 키와 값이 모두 같을 때
    value: gpu
    effect: NoSchedule    # 새 Pod 배치를 막는 taint 를 견딤
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx
EOF
answers.2:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: affinity-pod
spec:
  affinity:
    nodeAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:   # 반드시 만족해야 배치
        nodeSelectorTerms:
        - matchExpressions:
          - key: disktype
            operator: In      # 값이 목록 중 하나
            values:
            - ssd
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx
EOF
answers.3:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: spread-app
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: spread-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: spread-app
    spec:
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:   # 가능하면
          - weight: 100
            podAffinityTerm:
              labelSelector:
                matchLabels:
                  app: spread-app       # 같은 앱 Pod 를 피함
              topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname   # 같은 노드 기준
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx
EOF
answers.4:
kubectl patch deployment app -n $NS -p '{"spec":{"strategy":{"rollingUpdate":{"maxSurge":1,"maxUnavailable":0}}}}'


kubectl get deployment app -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.spec.strategy}'
answers.7:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: web-sts
spec:
  serviceName: web-headless    # 각 Pod 의 DNS 이름을 만들 Headless Service
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web-sts
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web-sts
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx
EOF

answers.9:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: graceful
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60   # 종료 신호 후 강제 종료까지 60초 대기
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx
    lifecycle:
      preStop:                         # 종료 직전에 실행
        exec:
          command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 5"]
EOF
